question: Can the integrated snap-turn and height-calibration paths run in native Prey with a floor reference?
claim: STAGE selected; held right stick produced one +45 snap and a fresh left deflection -45; crouched recenter preserved standing height while explicit calibration changed it. Native movement transform reached the consumer with simulator binding limitations.
method: Process-scoped xr-sim runtime and xr-tape 0.1.0; supported Invoke-PreyVRLaunch.ps1 at 1344x1440, controlled stick/head steps, native command reports, D3D11 captures, and 42 CTest checks. See report and frozen manifest for exact DLL identity.

identity.reason: Supported Steam landmarks and DLL hash in launch manifest.

instrument.reason: Native xr-tape plus world captures; shared-action simulator limit bounded explicitly.

control.reason: Held vs neutral/re-engaged sticks; height 1.6 to 1.1; ordinary vs explicit recenter.

scene.reason: Talos Lobby visible in captured world images.

baseline.reason: Visible native gameplay, 42/42 tests, no xrEndFrame errors; excludes menu appearance, independent simulator subactions and headset acceptance.

limits: xr-sim returns shared vector action values independent of hand subaction; movement used matching stick values. No headset acceptance, LOCAL_FLOOR, invalid STAGE fallback or runtime space-change live validation. Forced LOCAL launch blocked by Defender injector quarantine.
